sql: CREATE TABLE edge_j(id INT PRIMARY KEY,k INT)
SELECT a.id,b.id AS bid FROM edge_j a LEFT JOIN edge_j b ON a.k=b.k AND b.id=2 WHERE b.id IS NULL ORDER BY a.id
SELECT a.id,b.id AS bid FROM edge_j a LEFT JOIN edge_j b ON a.k IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.k ORDER BY a.id,b.id
SELECT a.id,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edge_j b WHERE b.k=a.k) AS n FROM edge_j a ORDER BY a.id
UPDATE edge_j a SET k=b.k+10 FROM edge_j b WHERE a.id=b.id AND a.k=1
SELECT id,k FROM edge_j ORDER BY id
